claims.statement: At the pinned snapshot the GitHub command palette is described as public preview and changeable. This is historical source phase, not live availability or stability certification; it is distinct from the editor command palette.

The command palette can narrow suggestions by adding a repository with Tab, expand them by removing scope items and clear scope/text through Clear or platform-specific deletion shortcuts. Suggestion filtering is not permission restriction, authorization for broader targets or deletion of repository data; no UI action occurred.

The pinned fragment says the GitHub command palette is disabled by default and can be enabled through feature preview. This is not verified current account state or authority to enable it; the linked early-access procedure remains separate.

The GitHub palette opens through Ctrl-K on Windows/Linux or Command-K on Mac and derives initial suggestion scope from current UI location. This differs from editor Shift-modified palette shortcuts; initial navigation scope is not a verified security boundary or user authorization.
